app.name: Testimonials
inbox.title: Testimonials
banner.pending.title: Reviews are waiting for approval
banner.pending.body: Nothing is published until you approve it.
inbox.empty.title: No testimonials yet
inbox.empty.body: Collect your first review, or add one manually.
record.trashConfirm: Move this review to trash? You can restore it from the Trash tab.
record.deleteForeverConfirm: Delete this review for good? This cannot be undone.
bulk.deleteForeverConfirm: Delete the selected reviews for good? This cannot be undone.
editor.quote.hint: The customer's own words, up to 500 characters.
editor.avatarUrl.hint: Optional. An image from this site's media library, or leave empty for initials.
editor.avatarUrl.invalid: Enter an image address from this site, or leave it empty.
editor.photoUrl.hint: Optional. A photo you attach from this site's media library. The form never accepts uploads, so every photo is one you chose.
editor.photoUrl.invalid: Enter an image address from this site, or leave it empty.
editor.videoUrl.hint: Optional. A YouTube or Vimeo address. The site shows a click-to-load player, so the video only loads when a visitor asks.
editor.videoUrl.invalid: Enter a YouTube or Vimeo address, or leave it empty.
editor.tag.hint: Optional, one short label such as 'Repairs'. A Testimonials block can show only one tag.
editor.locale.hint: Optional, a language tag like en-US or nl. The review then only shows on pages of the same language; empty shows it everywhere.
editor.locale.invalid: Enter a language tag like en-US or nl, or leave it empty.
editor.ownerReply.hint: Shown under the review on the site. Leave empty for no reply.
editor.note.hint: Only moderators see this. It is never shown on the site.
editor.verified.hint: Your own attestation that this customer is real. The site shows it as a small badge.
editor.rating.hint: Optional. Unrated reviews show no stars.
editor.consent.hint: You confirm the customer allowed these words to be shown.
settings.title: Settings
settings.notifyEmail.hint: Where new submissions are announced. Empty sends no email.
settings.notifyEmail.invalid: Enter a valid email address, or leave it empty.
settings.requireCaptcha.hint: Uses the site's own configured provider. Every submission is moderated either way.
settings.noCaptcha: The site has no CAPTCHA configured, so submissions rely on moderation alone.
settings.perBlock: Stars, avatars, and dates are chosen per block in the page builder: open the page, select the Testimonials block, and switch them there.
settings.layout.hint: Applies the chosen layout to every Testimonials block on this site and publishes the pages it touches. The choice is stored on the blocks themselves, so the page builder stays truthful.
settings.layout.none: No pages with a Testimonials block were found.
settings.layout.error: The layout could not be applied:
settings.minRating.hint: 0 shows everything. When a minimum is set, unrated reviews are hidden from the site but stay visible here.
collect.title: Collect reviews
collect.step1: Add the Review form block to a page
collect.step1.body: In the page builder, insert the Review form block wherever the form should appear. The form uses the site's CAPTCHA and every submission lands here as pending.
collect.step2: Tell the inbox where that page lives
collect.step2.body: Paste the page address below, including any language prefix (e.g. /nl-NL/reviews), so the links and QR code open the right page. The form on that page records the page's language for each review.
collect.url.hint: For example /reviews, or the full address.
collect.url.invalid: Enter the page address on this site (for example /reviews), or leave it empty.
collect.qr.title: Counter card
collect.qr.hint: A QR code of the reviews page: print it for the counter, scan it from a phone.
collect.qr.alt: QR code for the reviews page
collect.invite.title: Invite a customer
collect.invite.hint: Sends a personal invitation with the reviews page link. No scheduler, no drip — one email, sent now.
collect.invite.name: Customer name (optional)
collect.invite.name.hint: The invitation greets them by name and pre-fills the form.
collect.invite.note.hint: Added to the email, e.g. 'Thanks for the repair last week.'
collect.import.title: Import reviews
collect.import.hint: Paste CSV rows — quote, name, role, rating. Every row is moderated before it appears.
collect.import.consent: I confirm permission to publish was given
collect.import.consent.hint: Your attestation travels with every imported review, same as the editor's.
collect.linkReady: Share this link to collect reviews:
save.failed: Couldn't save - fix the highlighted field.
load.failed: Couldn't load the Testimonials admin data.
load.forbidden: Your account can't manage these settings.
noscript: This screen needs JavaScript to run.
